independentReference.calculationConvention: Five annual end-year FCFF; perpetuity terminal FCFF=NOPAT6*(1-g/terminalROIC); signed equity bridge; USD millions and million shares.

limitations: No independently refreshed valuation-date balance sheet, share count, cost of capital, equity bridge claims or security values.
Debt scope excludes leases; marketable securities are deliberately excluded from the illustrative equity adjustment.
No integrated projected balance sheet/cash flow statement, NOL schedule or SBC dilution model.
Publication date was not available in the saved fixture; no date is fabricated.
This is an evidence-backed arithmetic/user-flow example. Only two years are available; no forecast-accuracy backtest is supported.
Source text integrity and quote membership do not establish independent audited correctness.
Negative working capital proxy can provide cash during modeled growth; that result depends on stable supplier/customer timing.
